rate_limits: free API key (crtfc_key); ~20,000 calls/day per key
notes: Authoritative identity + financials for DART-registered companies (all listed + external-audit). corpCode.xml = full entity list (corp_code/name/stock_code). company.json = identity incl. jurir_no (13-digit corp reg no) + bizr_no (10-digit business/tax reg no). fnlttSinglAcnt(All) = XBRL financials (BS+IS) in KRW. Free key (crtfc_key); returns status 900 / 302 without it. Schema confirmed from the official API guide; no records fetched without a key.

organization: National Tax Service (국세청) via data.go.kr / odcloud
rate_limits: free service key via data.go.kr; per-key quota
notes: Lookup of business registration status (영업/휴업/폐업, tax type) by 사업자등록번호 (b_no, 10-digit). POST with a free data.go.kr service key; returns 401 '인증키는 필수 항목 입니다' without one. Validation/enrichment of tax status; not a company master. Join on the business registration number.

rate_limits: fee per registry extract; no bulk/API
notes: The full commercial register, including UNLISTED companies, run by the Supreme Court. Registry extracts (등기사항증명서) are fee-based per issue; no open bulk/API. The only complete source of company registration (incl. directors/capital/purpose). Cataloged from public docs only; directors are personal data (PIPA).

organization: Ministry of the Interior and Safety (NIA)
notes: National open-data portal hosting many company/tax datasets and APIs (incl. the NTS status API and FSC/KED-backed corporate-info APIs), each behind a free service key, mostly under KOGL (Korea Open Government Licence). The hub through which most non-DART company APIs are obtained.
